description: Backend state model for the live-model repair flow. Composes LiveModelAdmissionRecord + LiveDiagnoseTrace + QuarantinedPatchPlan + LiveTempPatchVerifierResult into a flat IDELiveModelRepairFlowState. Pure function; no I/O. human_approval is always HUMAN_APPROVAL_REQUIRED; source_mutation is always SOURCE_MUTATION_BLOCKED; training_eligibility is always TRAINING_ELIGIBLE_FALSE — even when temp_patch_verifier shows TEMP_PATCH_VERIFIER_PASSED.
purpose: Rung 6 of the live-local-model campaign. Exposes the live-model repair flow state to the IDE backend without building UI. Sets up CLAUDE_LANE_LIVE_MODEL_READY_FINAL_STATE_LOCK_001 (the campaign finale).
invariants: build_live_flow_state is a pure function over its inputs; no I/O.
human_approval is always HUMAN_APPROVAL_REQUIRED on every state.
source_mutation is always SOURCE_MUTATION_BLOCKED on every state.
training_eligibility is always TRAINING_ELIGIBLE_FALSE on every state.
Admission record with is_ready=True flips live_admission to LIVE_MODEL_ADMITTED; otherwise LIVE_MODEL_NOT_ADMITTED.
TEMP_PATCH_VERIFIER_PASSED does NOT open source_mutation — it stays BLOCKED.
scripts/ide/live_model_repair_flow_*.py contains no `import subprocess`, no `import urllib`.
